failed_claim_or_route: Exact first crossing-ring pair identity across natural and robust THINGS weighting.
failed_assumption: A physical front must remain in the same discrete common-beam ring pair under visibility reweighting.
retained_insight: All eight sectors remain resolved fronts and seven of eight first crossing pairs are exactly invariant despite the weighting intervention.
bold_leap: The physical object is a continuous azimuthal q=1 front sheet; a discrete ring-pair phase slip is allowed only when the interpolated sheet remains beam-local, ordered, and unbiased as a whole.
mechanism: Natural-versus-robust weighting perturbs the sampled q profile inside one synthesized support element, moving a threshold bracket without moving the underlying molecular-to-atomic isocontour coherently. The invariant is the continuous first-crossing radius field r_star(phi), not the integer ring pair.

domain_native_variables.r_left_kpc: center radius of the first eligible q>1 ring
domain_native_variables.r_right_kpc: center radius of its adjacent eligible q<1 ring
domain_native_variables.rho_front: Spearman correlation of the eight natural and robust r_star fields

solver_conventions.crossing_source: Use each weighting's already frozen first V149 crossing pair; do not search for a friendlier crossing.
solver_conventions.interpolation: Linear interpolation in q between the two reported ring centers.
solver_conventions.no_retuning: No pair substitution, smoothing, sector deletion, q threshold change, geometry change, or tolerance change after this freeze.

changed_risky_predictions: P150-P1: all eight matched non-NO_FRONT sectors have a valid first-pair q=1 interpolation.
P150-P2: max absolute normalized front-radius shift is at most one common-beam FWHM.
P150-P3: at least six of eight sectors and the median absolute shift are within 0.25 common-beam FWHM.
P150-P4: natural-versus-robust front-radius Spearman rho is at least 0.90 and absolute median signed shift is at most 0.15 beam.
orthodox_competitor: Weighting-dependent masking and line-of-sight structure need not preserve a continuous front sheet; they may produce multi-beam shifts, destroy azimuthal ordering, or create a coherent signed radial bias.
fresh_kill_condition: Kill exact V150 if any sector lacks a valid first-pair interpolation, max absolute shift exceeds 1.0 beam, fewer than six sectors or the median fail the 0.25-beam concentration gate, Spearman rho is below 0.90, or absolute median signed shift exceeds 0.15 beam. No tolerance or pair may be changed after outcome access.
credit: Retrospective same-pulse first discriminator only. V150 requires a new prospective galaxy for external credit.
